description: Send a sponsorship inquiry, including the sponsor's name, email, and optional phone and website, to a Soundcheck organization, which creates an inbound sponsor lead it follows up on. Requires organization_id, name, and email. User confirmation: nothing is sent until the person confirms by email: the call only emails a confirmation link to the address given, and the request reaches the organization after that person opens the email and clicks Confirm.

organization_id.description: the Soundcheck organization to approach (slug or id)

sponsorship_interest.description: what they want to sponsor / their interest

website.description: the sponsor's website or company URL

name: request_sponsorship

data.description: tool payload (API/composite/confirmation object); object, array, or primitive JSON

title: Request sponsorship
